title: Equipment

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

name.description: Display name, as in items.json (the game's UI table). Absent when the game has none.

damageContext.description: The target tag damage rules use for this piece, such as `Armor.Heavy` or `Helmet.SuperHeavy` (see `target` in damage.json). The `Meta.Damage.` prefix is dropped.

coveredLocations.description: Body parts the piece protects, such as `Torso.Upper` or `Head`.

durability.description: Hit points of the armor before it is spent.

damageReduction.description: Percent of damage the armor absorbs at this stage.

thickness.description: Plate thickness at this stage, as stored.

density.description: Plate density at this stage, as stored.

stages.description: How protection changes as the armor wears down, from new to nearly spent.

attribute.description: Attribute, for example `Weapon.AimTime` (the game's `Attribute.Gameplay.*` tag without the prefix).

op.description: How the value combines: `multiplyCompound` and `multiply` scale the attribute (1.1 is +10%), `add` adds, `override` replaces. Several `multiplyCompound` modifiers multiply together.

value.description: The number applied. For `multiply` and `multiplyCompound`, 1.1 means +10%.

items.description: One change an attachment makes to a gameplay attribute.

modifiers.description: Changes the piece makes to the wearer's attributes (speed, stamina and so on). Plain numbers only.

armor.description: Armor and helmets, sorted by item id.

minWeightKg.description: Carried weight in kilograms from which the class applies.

attribute.description: Attribute, for example `Weapon.AimTime` (the game's `Attribute.Gameplay.*` tag without the prefix).

op.description: How the value combines: `multiplyCompound` and `multiply` scale the attribute (1.1 is +10%), `add` adds, `override` replaces. Several `multiplyCompound` modifiers multiply together.

value.description: The number applied. For `multiply` and `multiplyCompound`, 1.1 means +10%.

items.description: One change an attachment makes to a gameplay attribute.

modifiers.description: Changes to the player while in this class (speed, jump, stamina regeneration, aim sway, aim time).

items.description: A tier of carried weight and what it does to the player.

weightClasses.description: Carried-weight tiers, lightest first. Item weights are in items.json.

description: Worn protection and the effect of carried weight.
